trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing extra to do beyond the full list. Plan your run around the two long poles: A Long Road (100% completion) and the handful of trophies flagged missable in this guide. Keep a manual save before the final story stretch so a missed one-chance moment never costs you a whole second playthrough.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the game. It is unmissable: simply play through the prologue, follow the on-screen prompts while the controls are introduced, and the trophy pops as the mission wraps up. If you are starting a fresh save, this is the first trophy you will earn.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 1. Chapters advance by finishing the gold story markers on the map, so just keep following the main missions in order. Nothing in Chapter 1 can be failed permanently; if a mission goes wrong you retry it, and the trophy unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 2. Keep working through the main story markers as either protagonist when prompted. Chapter 2 opens up more of Leonida, so it is a good point to start sampling side activities for Master of None, but nothing here is required beyond finishing the chapter's missions.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 3. Follow the story markers to the chapter's conclusion. By now both protagonists' routines are established, so use the downtime between missions to register vehicles, spend money in shops and make choices whenever the game offers them; those habits feed several long-term trophies at no extra cost.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 4. Continue through the main missions until the chapter closes. Before pushing into the endgame, consider making a separate manual save: the finale is close, and having a save from before it is cheap insurance for any one-chance moments you still want to tidy up.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for completing the final mission. Before you start it, finish anything flagged missable in this guide and save in a separate slot, because finales in this series can lock you into the ending sequence. Play the mission through to the credits; the trophy unlocks when the final mission is complete, whichever way the last scenes play out.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Breakfast Run. It is part of the main story path, so it cannot be skipped or failed permanently. Play it when its marker appears, follow the objectives, and the trophy pops at the mission's end. The name Trust is your hint that the mission is about the two leads learning to rely on each other.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing The Cartel Heist, one of the set-piece heists in the main story. Prepare like any heist: arrive with full health, armour and ammo for your preferred weapons. The trophy only asks for completion, not a clean or fast run, so take the loud or quiet approach you are comfortable with and see it through.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Child's Play. It sits on the main story path and unlocks as the mission ends. If a section gives you trouble, lower your exposure rather than your accuracy: stay in cover, let your partner draw fire, and push forward between enemy waves.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Headliners. Follow the story marker when it appears and play the mission to its conclusion. It is a required part of the campaign, so the only way to miss it is to stop playing the story; retries are always available if a section fails.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown, the story mission set around Vice City International Airport. Play it when it appears on the story path. While you are at the airport, remember Catch Me If You Can also involves VCIA, so it is worth poking around the airfield once the mission is done and you can explore freely.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Operation Savage Glory. A required campaign mission: follow its marker, complete the objectives and the trophy unlocks at the end. Bring your best loadout, as late-story missions tend to throw armoured enemies and vehicles at you in sequence.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold trophy for attaining 100% completion, the longest single task on the list. Use the in-game completion checklist as your source of truth and work it category by category: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the smaller one-off requirements. Almost every other trophy in this guide feeds into it, so leave it for last and treat it as a clean-up project: finish the story, clear the map icons, then sweep whatever percentage remains.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's scored daredevil moments: jumps, near misses and similar feats that register as you drive, ride and fly around Leonida. They accumulate naturally while exploring, but to grind them, find a repeatable stunt jump or a long highway run and repeat it with a fast, durable vehicle. Check your running total in the stats menu so you know how far you have to go.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game tracks nine activity types, things like races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation and hunting. You do not need to win or finish most of them; you only need to sample each type a single time. Most types are introduced by map icons or stranger missions, so a tour of Leonida's icons early on will tick off most of the list.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting ranges, pick a challenge and learn its target pattern; gold is about accuracy and time, so replay each challenge until the route through its targets is muscle memory. Use the weapon the challenge favours, control your recoil with short bursts, and do not be discouraged by early silvers: every challenge can be retried immediately, as often as you like.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location, 14 in all. Unlike Master of None, sampling is not enough here: you must actually finish first at each location. Learn each course with a practice run, take the racing line through the gates rather than chasing shortcuts, and feather the throttle in tight sections instead of crashing and losing more time. Locations can be retried freely, so work through them one by one.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The key word is different: winning the same event twenty times does not count. Leonida offers far more than twenty race events across its cars, bikes, boats and aircraft, so tour the race icons on the map and win each once. If a race is too hard, come back with a better vehicle in that class rather than grinding the same event.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal through the fishing spots and accept his challenge, then out-catch him within its rules. Play the fishing mechanics patiently: cast to where fish are rising, keep steady tension on the line while reeling, and ease off when the fish runs so the line does not snap. Bigger, cleaner catches beat frantic ones, and the challenge can be retried if Cal wins the first round.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Arcade cabinets sit in bars, arcades and similar interiors around Leonida; walk up to one, start a game and play it through to completion rather than quitting at the first game over. Pick the shortest cabinet game you find if you just want the trophy, and note that sampling an arcade game also counts toward Master of None.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, which means following his stranger strand from its first question-mark icon to its conclusion. Stranger strands are chains: finish one mission and the next appears on the map later, sometimes after a delay or a phone message. If Andy's next step is not showing, play other content and check the map again. Finishing his strand also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton by working through his whole stranger strand. Start it from his map icon, then keep returning whenever a new step appears; strands can pause between missions, so a quiet map does not mean the strand is over. The trophy pops at the end of his last mission, and the strand counts toward the eight needed for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy by finishing his stranger strand end to end. As with the other strands, start at his question-mark icon and follow each follow-up mission until the chain concludes. Keep an eye on your phone between missions, since some steps are triggered by messages rather than map icons. His strand also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. A strand only counts when you finish its final mission, not when you start it. The named strands in this guide (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone) are five of them, so you need at least three more from the other strangers scattered around the map. Work strands as they appear while exploring, and use the completion checklist to see how many you have banked.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy by following his stranger strand to the end. Start from his map icon and keep clearing each new step as it unlocks; some steps only appear at certain times of day or after story progress, so if the trail goes cold, advance the story and look again. Finishing counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone by playing his stranger strand through to its conclusion. Begin at his question-mark icon and follow the chain; if a follow-up does not appear straight away, sleep or play something else and check the map again later. The trophy unlocks at the end of his final mission, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida, 18 in all. Spots sit in quiet, scenic places: overlooks, beaches, hilltops and similar pauses in the chaos. When you reach one, use the prompt and stay for the full meditation rather than cancelling out. They are quick to clear while exploring, and a systematic sweep region by region, checking the map for spots you have not used, is the fastest way to finish.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is your way into the hunting activity: meet him, take his request and track the specific unique animal he names rather than ordinary wildlife. Follow the tracking prompts, approach downwind and quietly, and make the kill clean when you get your shot. Trying hunting also ticks one activity type off Master of None.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida, and each set is only complete when you hold every card in it, so a pile of loose cards is not enough. Use the collection menu to see which sets are closest to finished, then hunt the missing cards in those sets first. Cards reward slow, observant exploration of interiors, rooftops and landmarks; three full sets is a much smaller job than collecting every card in the game.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are marked places around Leonida where you stop and use the WAiNK prompt; each location counts once. They are spread across the whole map, so this pairs naturally with The Goodtime State and the collectible hunts: sweep one district at a time instead of crossing the map for single spots, and check your stats counter regularly so you know when you are closing in on 100.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's standalone objectives, tracked in the challenges menu, separate from missions and activities. Many complete themselves during normal play (driving, combat and exploration feats), so check the menu periodically, see which ones are nearly done, and deliberately finish the cheap ones: short, repeatable challenges are the fastest route to 50. You do not need every challenge in the game, just fifty of them.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need both protagonists together in free roam: get into trouble until the wanted level reaches four stars, then break line of sight and stay hidden while the search fades. The classic method works: ditch the vehicle the police saw, change cars, and hide somewhere out of the search area, a parking structure, alley or off-road spot, until the stars drain away completely.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The trap is the middle condition: between robberies your wanted level must never fully disappear. Plan a route of three shops close together beforehand, rob the first, move straight to the second while still wanted, then the third, keeping the heat alive the whole way. Your partner must be with you, so set this up in free roam with both leads together, and bring a fast car for the hops between shops.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle model is discovered when you get in and drive it, so this is a car-spotting exercise: steal and briefly drive every distinct model you see. Traffic variety changes by district and wealth level, so tour rich neighbourhoods, industrial areas, the airport and the countryside rather than circling one block. Showrooms, garages you own and vehicles delivered by contacts all count, and the stats menu tracks how many models you have found.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows the action so you can place shots precisely, but it only lasts a few seconds, so set the scene first: find a group of at least five enemies close together (gang operations and police standoffs work well), line up your most accurate weapon, then trigger Focus and drop them one by one without wasting shots. If you run dry at four, reload before triggering it next time and pick a tighter group.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: steal an aircraft from the airfield and take off without clearance. Slip onto the tarmac, pick a plane that is ready to go, get in and get airborne quickly before the response pins you down. It pairs naturally with the VCIA Takedown story mission's location, but it is easiest done in free roam when you can choose your moment and your aircraft.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke with a serious subject: Rhinos are the army's tanks, and it gets hot inside one. This hidden trophy revolves around the Rhino itself: when military hardware rolls out at the highest wanted levels, either commandeer a Rhino or survive an encounter with one, depending on how the moment finds you. Practical advice: keep an explosive or heavy weapon handy at five stars, approach a stopped Rhino from behind if you mean to steal it, and do not stand in front of the cannon either way.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth job, not a smash and grab: case the store, go in quietly, and avoid raising any alarm or witness report. Work fast and clean inside, do not draw a weapon in view of the street, and have your escape route planned before you start so you are gone before anyone reacts. If you are spotted, let the attempt go and try again another day rather than forcing it; an undetected run is the whole point.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the heavy end of the robbery ladder: expect planning, resistance and a serious wanted level on the way out, and remember the trophy needs the escape as well as the robbery, so a bust at the door does not count. Work up to banks after practising on shops and armored trucks, bring your best crew setup and loadout, and plan the getaway before you crack the vault. Five separate successful vault robberies are required.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks appear on the roads of Leonida carrying cash; ambush one away from heavy traffic, breach the rear doors (force or explosives both work, though explosives bring more heat), grab the money and then lose the wanted level to complete the escape. Picking a truck near a good hiding spot or a fast road out makes the getaway much easier.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: all 52 named areas on the map. An area counts once you have actually been there and it registers as discovered, so this is a grand tour: drive the highways, detour into every town, swamp, key and island, and check the map for greyed-out pockets you have somehow skipped. Aircraft make the islands and coastline quick to sweep. Leave it until late, when story and collectibles have already taken you to most of the state, then mop up what is left.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang, nine gangs in all. Each gang holds its own territory and its own operations, so this is a tour of Leonida's underworld: identify which gang runs an operation before you hit it, and keep a note of which gangs you have already robbed so you do not repeat the same one. Gang operations are tougher than shops, so go in armed and with an exit planned. One operation per gang is enough.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The simplest trophy on the list: head to the Ocean Beach strip, find a beachfront bar, order a cocktail and drink it while looking out at the water. The trophy name, In The Beginning, is a wink at the series' history, and the moment is deliberately peaceful, so slow down and let the drink finish rather than cancelling out of the animation.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into one of the display cars inside a vehicle showroom and drive it straight out through the showroom glass. Any showroom with cars on display and a glass front will do: pick the car facing the window, floor it, and enjoy the series' oldest joke. Expect a wanted level for the damage, so be ready to leave the area afterwards.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Find that specific bowling alley, start a game of bowling there and play it properly, following through on your throws rather than just lobbing the ball. Bowling at the right alley also samples the bowling activity for Master of None. If your first game is rough, replay it; the trophy is about bowling at that alley, not about a perfect score.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A deliberately vague hidden trophy: a partnership with mass appeal points at the two leads doing things together that the world notices. The honest guide is that it is tied to playing as the duo rather than to a single marked objective, so spend time in free roam with both protagonists together, do partner activities and crimes as a pair (Hot Together and Retail Therapy are good habits), and it should unlock through natural co-operative play rather than one specific trick.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse): this trophy counts the decisions you actively make across the game, in story moments and in the world, and the tracker runs to 500. We flag it as missable for one reason: story choices are one-chance events. A choice you let pass, or a decision point in a mission you rush through, cannot be revisited without replaying that part of the game, so a passive playthrough can strand you short of choices that were there to be made. Protect yourself by choosing actively whenever the game offers a decision instead of letting timers expire, and keep a manual save before major story missions so a skipped decision point can be replayed from just before it.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: the trophy rewards succeeding on a retry, after a first attempt has gone wrong. We flag it as missable as a precaution: if the attempt it refers to is a one-off story or strand moment and you ace it first try, there may be no second attempt to succeed on in that playthrough. The safe play is, whenever an activity or mission offers you a retry after a failure, take the retry and succeed on it rather than reloading a save to erase the failure; and keep a manual save before one-off missions so you can deliberately fail once and then succeed if you reach the endgame without it.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? is the whole description, and it means it: this hidden trophy is for witnessing one of Leonida's strange encounters, the kind of weird moment the state hides off the beaten path. Explore rural Leonida at night, the swamps, the keys and the empty places between towns, and when something odd starts happening, stay and watch it play out instead of driving on. There is no marker for it; curiosity is the guide.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock someone down by striking them with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly alongside a target, use the melee attack from the driver's seat as you pass, and the hit needs to floor them, not just clip them. Practise somewhere quiet with a sturdy car until the timing feels natural; it is a timing trophy, not a power one, so speed control matters more than the vehicle you pick.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, money that cannot be spent until it is cleaned. Take them to your laundering contacts whenever you are carrying them, and keep robbing (shops, trucks, vaults and gang operations all feed this) until the cumulative laundered total reaches a quarter of a million. The stats menu tracks the running total, so check it after each drop-off to see how much dirt is left to wash.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. This is cumulative spending in any shops: clothes, weapons, ammunition, vehicle work, food and services all count. It comes naturally if you actually use your money instead of hoarding it, and the garage properties and upgrades you buy for other trophies push it along quickly. If you reach the endgame short of the mark, a deliberate shopping spree on vehicles and weapons closes the gap in minutes.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties, eight in all. Garages are bought from the for-sale signs at the properties themselves or through the in-game property listings, and they double as storage for your growing vehicle collection. They are a money trophy in disguise: save robbery income rather than spending it all, buy garages as you can afford them district by district, and the laundering and robbery trophies will fund the later ones. The completion checklist confirms when you own all eight.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you are in a vehicle you want to keep track of, open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register it; ten different vehicles are needed. It pairs perfectly with Whip It Good: every time you hop into a new model to discover it, register it in the app before you ditch it, and both counters climb together.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (trophy name, description and grade as published, 2026-11-18); cross-checked against Exophase's GTA VI trophy page.
